## AI assistance

See the [AI Policy](https://github.com/scikit-hep/mplhep/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#ai-policy). Pick one:

- [ ] No AI was used, or only for translation/grammar.
- [ ] AI was used. Tool and model: <!-- e.g. claude-code:claude-opus-5 -->
